project: Engenharia Reversa / original REA Linux VPS
goal: Verify completeness of full original REA Evidence and Unknown revision history across independently exported before/after bundles, without reading or modifying production evidence.

test_execution.location: Isolated local Linux container, not owner VPS; Python 3.13 stdlib unittest
test_groups: Exact before/after bundle with Evidence and two linked Unknown revisions passes
Valid full bundle without Unknown revisions passes
Changed evidence payload with same ID rejected
Self-comparison and same inode hardlink rejected

schema_grounding.note: Original full bundle has artifacts/providers/environments/scenarios/captures/unknowns/records; Unknowns sorted by id and revision.
Original Unknown revision uses unknown_id, revision, previous_revision_digest and revision_digest.
Original ID formats use ev_/unk_ followed by 64 lowercase hexadecimal digits.

safety_limits: Comparator has no server/MCP communications and no owner key access or signature granting.
Two actual original REA validated full Evidence bundle files are required before comparing; this phase used only synthetic fixtures, never original P214 private bytes.
Python semantic SHA256 is for offline comparison, not native REA RFC8785 canonical digest or a substitute for original REA schema/manifest integrity checks.

Running comparator does not release original P232 operational hold or change original REA close_binary semantics; no target session may be opened/closed in permanent MCP until signed, independently verified durability/restore is established.
No new tool has been functionally certified during P237.
